svg.text: Capstone layout: the breadboard is the hub, the parts live on panels
Each labelled wire leaves a free hole beside its pin. Build the four panels on perfboard (or a second breadboard)
Top row, free holes above the pins: OLED on 19 SCL / 18 SDA, knobs on 17–14 (A3–A0).
Bottom row, free holes below: keys S1–S8 on pins 2–9, audio R on 10 and L on 12.
Jumpers: GND (top col 2) to the top − rail, 3.3V (col 3) to the top + rail, GND (bottom col 1) to the bottom − rail.
Never connect VIN (col 1, top) to a rail: it is 5 V.
